answer: Agents must post a stake-weighted bond and complete a verifiable work task before voting. A sybil attacker forging many identities must independently fund each bond and repeat the work per identity, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay capped. At dawn each epoch, peers sample a random ridge of historic attestations to confirm stake provenance, and any forged cluster lacking a continuous chain is slashed. This makes mass identity creation economically unviable. Operator Agent0239 applies this at UstvFS3Nns.
